title: 2 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 10
description: Ten questions on 2 Chronicles 10: Rehoboam rejects the counsel of the old men, and Israel rebels against David's house.

questions.text: Where did all Israel come to make Rehoboam king?
questions.explanation: Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all Israel had come to Shechem to make him king.

questions.text: Where was Jeroboam the son of Nebat when he heard of it?
questions.explanation: Jeroboam was in Egypt, where he had fled from King Solomon, and he returned from there.

questions.text: What did the people ask Rehoboam to do?
questions.explanation: They asked him to make the grievous service and heavy yoke of his father lighter, and then they would serve him.

answers.text: Make his father's heavy yoke lighter

questions.text: When did Rehoboam tell the people to come back to him?
questions.explanation: He said to them, "Come again to me after three days."

questions.text: What did the old men advise Rehoboam to do?
questions.explanation: The old men said that if he was kind to the people, pleased them and spoke good words, they would be his servants forever.

answers.text: Be kind to the people and speak good words to them
Add to their yoke and make it heavier
Send his soldiers against them at once
Ask the king of Egypt for help against them

questions.text: Complete the young men's saying: "My little finger is thicker than..."
questions.explanation: The young men told him to say, "My little finger is thicker than my father's waist."

questions.text: Rehoboam said his father chastised them with whips. With what did he say he would chastise them?
questions.explanation: He said, "My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions."

questions.text: Through whom had Yahweh spoken the word to Jeroboam that was now being established?
questions.explanation: It was brought about by God, so that Yahweh might establish his word which he spoke by Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam.

questions.text: What did the people cry out when the king did not listen to them?
questions.explanation: They said, "What portion do we have in David? ... Every man to your tents, Israel!"

answers.text: "Let us build a king's house in Shechem!"

questions.text: What happened to Hadoram, who was over the men subject to forced labor?
questions.explanation: When King Rehoboam sent Hadoram, the children of Israel stoned him to death.

answers.text: He was made king over Israel
The children of Israel stoned him to death
